'''Kombat Duel #5''' is a 1on1 double-elimination bracket league run by {{Player|alice|flag=se}}, starting April 19, 2023. While match scheduling is done in old fashioned quakeworld manners, the maps are a mix of brand new kenya and standard maps. Each match always start with map [[Zeit]] (followed by normal pick order) which is a clever way of introducing the just released map into action, giving every player equal conditions. Join the  [https://discord.gg/2qkVVan724 DISCORD].

== Format ==
* Double-elimination bracket
** {{Abbr|BO5|Best of 5}} matches
** {{Abbr|BO7|Best of 7}} Grand Final (1 map advantage to UB)
* 4 days of scheduling per round
* Map order:
** Start map is always '''ZEIT'''
** Remaining maps: '''DM4 • AEROWALK • ZTNDM3 • BRAVADO'''

== Info & Rules ==
* Map order: '''ZEIT - PICK - PICK - PICK - PICK'''
** Start map is always [[Zeit]]
** Bo5: Loser of first map pick 2nd map. If the score is 0:2 the loser of 2nd map picks 3rd map too. Otherwise take turns in picking.
** Bo7 Grand final: initially same as bo5, and after 5th map the map-pool resets and next player pick from all 5 maps again.
* Ping rules
** Keep ping difference even, more than 14 ping difference per player can be considered uneven. If server cannot be found where ping difference is even enough, then use cl_delay_packet to even it out until 14 ping difference. 
** This is a EU tournament. European players are not required to play on higher than 52 ping
** If someone cannot find a EU server with less than 52 ping he is considered a "non-EU player" 
** Non-EU players should play on a server where opponent have around 38-52 ping (usually ireland/london servers). If the EU player has less than 38 the non-EU player can demand opponent to ping up to 38.
* Client: ezQuake 3.2.x or 3.6.x
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Forfeiting first map in a series may result in disqualification from tournament.
* PayPal account required to receive transfer of prize money.
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|alice|flag=se}}
